Answer key source (report lane, 2026-10-10)

data/snapshots/ is empty in this worktree, and real Portal pages stay gitignored
because they carry agents' names and phone numbers. This folder holds handwritten
pages only — no real advert HTML.

1. tests/fixtures/rumah123_bintaro.html
   URL: https://www.rumah123.com/en/property/tangerang-selatan-bintaro/fixture-hos1/
   Shape: rumah123 JSON-LD. Required fields a human reads from the page:
   price_rp=875000000, land_m2=55 (from "Land Area: 55 m2" in the description;
   structured data on this Portal often omits land), building_m2=60, bedrooms=2,
   bathrooms=2, area=Bintaro, property_type=house, readiness=ready.

2. tests/fixtures/ninety_nine_bsd.html
   URL: https://www.99.co/id/properti/fixture-bsd
   Shape: 99.co __NEXT_DATA__. Required fields:
   price_rp=1100000000, land_m2=57, building_m2=60, bedrooms=2, bathrooms=2,
   area=BSD/Serpong, property_type=house, readiness=ready.

3. Rows 3–40 in eval/answer_key.jsonl
   Documented sample covering the seven Areas (Bintaro, BSD/Serpong, Gading
   Serpong, Depok, Yogyakarta, Sleman, Bantul). URLs are https://example.test/listings/...
   Field values are chosen so eval/score.py can run before real Snapshots exist.
   Gold Deals for the sample Shortlist are not flagged in the key (URL and
   fields only); they are the ranked rows in eval/sample_run.json.

Replace this key with a 40-row read of real Snapshots once data/snapshots/ is filled.
